testflight_internal.description: Archive Madeleine, export an IPA, and upload to TestFlight for internal testing. Build number is auto-managed by the Xcode Run Script phase (git commit count). Signing uses the App Store Connect API key from .env (ASC_KEY_ID / ASC_ISSUER_ID / ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH) when set, so it does not depend on an Apple ID being signed into Xcode.

steps.name: validate_version
steps.run: if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then echo "VERSION is required (e.g. asc workflow run testflight_internal VERSION:1.0)" >&2; exit 1; fi

steps.name: archive
steps.run: AUTH_FLAGS=""; if [ -n "$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH" ]; then AUTH_FLAGS="--xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyPath --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_KEY_ID --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyIssuerID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_ISSUER_ID"; fi; asc xcode archive --project "$PROJECT_PATH" --scheme "$SCHEME" --configuration "$CONFIGURATION" --archive-path ".asc/artifacts/Madeleine-$VERSION.xcarchive" --clean --overwrite --xcodebuild-flag=-destination --xcodebuild-flag=generic/platform=iOS --xcodebuild-flag=-allowProvisioningUpdates $AUTH_FLAGS --xcodebuild-flag=MARKETING_VERSION=$VERSION --output json

steps.name: export
steps.run: AUTH_FLAGS=""; if [ -n "$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH" ]; then AUTH_FLAGS="--xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyPath --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_KEY_ID --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyIssuerID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_ISSUER_ID"; fi; asc xcode export --archive-path ${steps.archive.ARCHIVE_PATH} --export-options "$EXPORT_OPTIONS" --ipa-path ".asc/artifacts/Madeleine-$VERSION.ipa" --overwrite --xcodebuild-flag=-allowProvisioningUpdates $AUTH_FLAGS --output json

testflight_external.description: Archive Madeleine, export an IPA, upload to TestFlight, attach to an External Beta Group, and submit for Beta App Review. Pass GROUP:<name|id>. Pass SUBMIT_BETA:false to skip review submission for subsequent builds of an already-approved version. Signing uses the App Store Connect API key from .env (ASC_KEY_ID / ASC_ISSUER_ID / ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH) when set, so it does not depend on an Apple ID being signed into Xcode.

steps.name: validate_inputs
steps.run: if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then echo "VERSION is required (e.g. VERSION:1.0)" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ -z "$GROUP" ]; then echo "GROUP is required (External Beta Group name or ID; e.g. GROUP:'Public Beta')" >&2; exit 1; fi

steps.name: archive
steps.run: AUTH_FLAGS=""; if [ -n "$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH" ]; then AUTH_FLAGS="--xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyPath --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_KEY_ID --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyIssuerID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_ISSUER_ID"; fi; asc xcode archive --project "$PROJECT_PATH" --scheme "$SCHEME" --configuration "$CONFIGURATION" --archive-path ".asc/artifacts/Madeleine-$VERSION.xcarchive" --clean --overwrite --xcodebuild-flag=-destination --xcodebuild-flag=generic/platform=iOS --xcodebuild-flag=-allowProvisioningUpdates $AUTH_FLAGS --xcodebuild-flag=MARKETING_VERSION=$VERSION --output json

steps.name: export
steps.run: AUTH_FLAGS=""; if [ -n "$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH" ]; then AUTH_FLAGS="--xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyPath --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_KEY_ID --xcodebuild-flag=-authenticationKeyIssuerID --xcodebuild-flag=$ASC_ISSUER_ID"; fi; asc xcode export --archive-path ${steps.archive.ARCHIVE_PATH} --export-options "$EXPORT_OPTIONS" --ipa-path ".asc/artifacts/Madeleine-$VERSION.ipa" --overwrite --xcodebuild-flag=-allowProvisioningUpdates $AUTH_FLAGS --output json

steps.name: publish
steps.run: set --; if [ "$SUBMIT_BETA" = "true" ]; then set -- "$@" --submit --confirm; fi; if [ -n "$TEST_NOTES" ]; then set -- "$@" --test-notes "$TEST_NOTES" --locale "$TEST_NOTES_LOCALE"; fi; asc publish testflight --app "$APP_ID" --ipa ${steps.export.IPA_PATH} --group "$GROUP" --wait "$@" --output json
